name: extension_td_palette_trusted
why: An extension resolving through a TD palette shortcut is TD's own code, not a danger surface -- it must not be counted.
divergence: POLICY. scanner.py exempts extensions resolving through a TD palette shortcut (_is_td_palette_ref: 'TD's own trusted code'); scanner-ts has no such carve-out. SCANNER-SPEC.md says plainly 'Count each extension-bearing COMP' with no exemption, so scanner-ts matches the spec letter and scanner.py carries an undocumented carve-out. Decision needed: document the carve-out in C8 and port it, or drop it from scanner.py.
